cim: Google value plummets by $500 billion as artificial intelligence searches impact ad revenue.
cim_eredeti: Google value plummets by $500 billion as artificial intelligence searches impact ad revenue.
szoveg_eredeti: Google's parent company Alphabet has lost more than $500 billion in market value after warning that AI-generated search summaries are affecting advertising revenue, while investors grow increasingly concerned about the enormous cost of the technology race.

prioritas.lead_hu: Az Alphabet piaci értéke jelentősen csökkent, miután a cég jelezte, hogy az AI-összefoglalók negatívan befolyásolják a hirdetési bevételeket.
